data.body: [P2] Account for the expected older-core rejection. With released 2.2.1 supplied as `--old-core`, the `old/new` probe fails at `provider.createPlugin()` because the current plugin deliberately requires `supportsSameThreadInvocationHooks()`. This branch then aborts before testing `new/old` and `new/new`, so the documented released/current matrix cannot complete. Verify the expected capability-rejection diagnostic for unsupported pairs, continue through supported combinations, and correct the README's claim that older cores retain tracing.
